name: base_shirt
description: A long-sleeved shirt, cut out of the body that wears it: the torso from just below the waist to the neck, and the arms from the wrist up. Closer to the body and thinner than the jacket, which is what makes one the layer under the other. The cuff sits at the wrist rather than partway down the arm because the bases are A-posed -- a level cut across a diagonal arm is a long oblique slice through a vertex grid, which comes out as a torn hem rather than a sleeve.
